# Concurrency & Cache — Org Guiding Principle

## Distributed Locks
- Clamp effective timeout to minimum 1ms when adjusting for clock skew.
- Annotate via orgops.tracing.annotate_span("lock.acquired", key) on acquisition.

## TTL Jitter
- ADD jitter to base TTL (never subtract — subtraction can produce negative TTLs).
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("cache.ttl.jittered", effective_ttl) for monitoring.

## Stampede Prevention
- Refresh early when time_remaining/ttl < threshold (close to expiry), not > threshold.
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("cache.stampede.prevented", key) when early refresh triggers.

## LFU Eviction
- Decay frequency by age: score = access_count / (1 + age_hours).
- Emit orgops.metrics.emit("cache.eviction.lfu", score) on eviction decisions.

## Write-Behind Buffers
- Convert interval_seconds to milliseconds (* 1000) when passing to timer APIs.
- Write orgops.auditing.write_event("cache.flush.completed", items_flushed=n) after flush.

## Consistent Hashing
- Use hash(key) % num_partitions (not num_partitions + 1 — causes out-of-range).
- Report orgops.health.report_degradation("cache.partition.skew", partition_id) on assignment.
